finding: The subject selects `specs/request-consistency.md#requirements` (subject line 21), and its acceptance criterion (subject line 25) relies on the promotion request binding being verified. The request contains no Input snapshot with filePath `specs/request-consistency.md`. The request binding that `specs/promotion-runtime.md#requirements` relies on (line 11) therefore cannot be compared with its selected source, and the selected reference cannot be checked against the submitted design.

The selected conditional requirement applies only if the reader link target `docs/reference/validation-report.md` is a generated artifact; if it is a manually maintained document, the section does not apply. No Input states which kind of document that target is, so the obligation that depends on this fact cannot be determined. The generated branch also names `docs/adr/0005-external-policy.md#decision` as the authoritative source, but that ADR scopes its authority to promotion artifact retention ("本次 promotion artifact retention 的 authoritative source"), so the request does not establish an in-scope authority for exporting a reader target.

The selected reference `specs/image-cache.md#preview-cleanup` requires that documentation-renderer image previews are removed from the preview cache after 24 hours. The subject states that "本 issue 的交付只包括本段明确列出的行为", and the listed deliverables contain no image preview or preview cache behavior. No requirement or acceptance criterion depends on this cleanup, so the selection is unrelated to the deliverable and cannot authorize implementation work.

The selected runtime-migration requirement states that the successful `promote(inputPath)` result is exactly `{status: 'succeeded', artifactId, trackedStateId}`. The selected result-summary requirement requires the same successful result to include a string `summary` whose value is `${artifactId} promoted to ${trackedStateId}`. Both references are selected for this issue, so the successful caller-visible result has two incompatible definitions.

The selected runtime-migration requirement states that the expected filesystem failure is exactly `{recovered: false, failureCode, priorTrackedState, baselineStatus}`, with no `operation` field, while stating that the other failure semantics follow Promotion Runtime. The selected promotion-runtime requirement (line 11) requires the structured diagnostics of its Interfaces section, and that section (line 41) defines the same expected failure as `{recovered: false, failureCode, operation, priorTrackedState, baselineStatus}`. The two selected contracts therefore give different caller-visible failure shapes for the same promote operation.

The 30-day retention obligation is established: tracked promotion artifacts are kept for 30 days after the tracked commit, and the downstream persistence consumes the applied selection (line 15). However, the same line states that "期满后的移除不属于本 operation", and no selected requirement, Input snapshot or ADR assigns expiry handling or removal to an owner; ADR 0005 only states that Readiness applies the policy. Whether tracked artifacts are removed at expiry, and by which owner, is unresolved, so the retention requirement cannot be shown to be implementable or verifiable as a durable-state lifecycle.

For protected operations, rules/01 says the caller boundary hands the verified principal and requested operation to the review boundary. The selected runtime-migration requirement describes protected promotion as accepting only internal requests whose access control is complete, and states that "promotion 不评估或选择授权 policy" (line 15). The selected access-review requirement applies its allowedOperations policy only to a read of an artifact (lines 5 and 15). No selected requirement says whether a promote request reaches the review boundary or which allowed operation governs it, so the authorization decision for this protected write operation is unresolved. That is a security decision that must be settled before the requirement can be implemented and verified.
